title: Copilot Studio: cost visibility in agent evaluations
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, documented credit display, licensing and spending controls are supported. The governance checklist names consumption monitoring that has no corresponding controls-table row, a minor completeness issue.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Evaluate credit figures are near-real-time approximations.
claims.quote: The estimates in Preview and Evaluate are near-real-time approximations

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Monitor's Total estimated credits used metric is the authoritative consumption figure once processing completes.
claims.quote: review the Total estimated credits used metric for your agent. This value reflects the number of Copilot Credits that will be billed for the selected period and serves as the source of truth for credit consumption reporting.

claims.claim: Final credit figures in Monitor can lag by a few hours.
claims.quote: Those events are then processed, and the final, accurate number is reflected in Monitor within a few hours.

claims.claim: Monitor is updated a few times a day.
claims.quote: The view in Monitor is updated a few times a day and shows the accurate number of credits consumed for all events processed up to that point.

claims.claim: Preview evaluations run with the currently signed-in user profile.
claims.quote: Evaluations and connections used by tools run with the currently signed-in user profile. You can't connect with a different user while you're signed in.

claims.claim: The preview evaluation uses that signed-in maker's tool connections.
claims.quote: User profile: The authenticated profile that runs the evaluation and connects to tools. Evaluations use the profile of the signed-in user.

claims.claim: An evaluation sends test conversation messages to the agent.
claims.quote:
User messages: The test messages sent to the agent.
Agent responses: The agent's actual responses.

claims.claim: The evaluation scores the agent's responses.
claims.quote: Test methods define how the agent's responses are scored. Currently, the only available test method is General quality, an AI-based assessment of whether responses meet quality standards, such as relevance and completeness.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs, not to the individual maker or user.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs, from prepaid capacity or through the environment's pay-as-you-go billing plan, and not to the individual makers or users who run agents.

claims.claim: Environment usage can draw from prepaid capacity.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs, from prepaid capacity or through the environment's pay-as-you-go billing plan

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: The reviewed pages publish no evaluation-specific credit rate for generation, test runs or grading.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Microsoft Copilot harness evaluation generation grading credit rate; opened billing-credit-overview, billing-credit-understand-display, evaluation intro/create/view and manage-usage-microsoft-copilot-harness. No evaluation-specific rate stated.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Not yet published
claims.claim: The standard-harness evaluation pages do not state whether running evaluations consumes credits.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio standard harness agent evaluation consume credits billing; opened standard-harness analytics-agent-evaluation-intro, analytics-agent-evaluation-results, analytics-agent-evaluation-create and analytics-agent-evaluation-overview. No evaluation billing statement.

claims.claim: The standard-harness evaluation pages do not mention credit figures.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio standard harness agent evaluation consume credits billing; opened standard-harness analytics-agent-evaluation-intro, analytics-agent-evaluation-results, analytics-agent-evaluation-create and analytics-agent-evaluation-overview. No credit display described.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot harness preview limits a test set to 20 conversations.
claims.quote: Conversations per test set | 20 | A message tells you when you reach the limit. To generate or write more conversations, first delete some existing conversations.

claims.claim: The maker path for run results is agent > Evaluate > recent results > evaluation.
claims.quote:
1. Open your agent in Copilot Studio.
2. Select the Evaluate tab.
3. Under recent results, select an evaluation with a prior test run to view its results.

claims.claim: An API equivalent for the preview's per-run and per-test-case estimated credit display is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio evaluation results estimated credits API Dataverse evaluationrun Power Platform CLI; opened pac copilot-studio, REST Bots and Get Maker Evaluation Test Run. Results APIs exist, but their documented response has no credit fields.

claims.claim: Environment capacity settings are at Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.
claims.quote:
select Licensing.
Under Products, select Copilot Studio.
Select Manage Copilot Credits.
Select the environment.
Enter the number of Copilot Credits to allocate.
Under Capacity overages, clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.

claims.claim: PUT /licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 with scope.environmentId, MCSMessages allocation.quantity and TenantPool enabled false allocates credits and disables tenant-pool draw.
Capacity management requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.
claims.quote: To manage Copilot Studio capacity, you need the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: A published environment-group rule governing tenant-pool draw makes the environment setting read-only.
claims.quote: When you publish a rule, it governs every environment in the group. The environment-level setting becomes read-only in the Power Platform admin center, and programmatic requests can't override it.

claims.claim: Programmatic updates that try to override the published tenant-pool rule are rejected with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.claim: The allocation API base URL is https://api.powerplatform.com.
claims.quote: $apiBaseUrl    = "https://api.powerplatform.com"

claims.claim: The cited monthly-limit path is Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit.
claims.quote:
1. In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio.
2. Select Manage Agents.
3. Select the agent, and then select Set limit.

claims.claim: An API or command equivalent for configuring an agent monthly limit and Stop usage is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Platform API Copilot Studio agent monthly consumption limit Stop usage PowerShell Dataverse; monthly limit pac copilot-studio; Dataverse bot consumption limit; PowerShell Copilot limit credits. Opened REST Bots, pac copilot-studio and capacity management; no matching write operation.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Cost and licensing: Caps; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Allocating credits and clearing tenant-pool draw bounds prepaid consumption to the environment allocation.
claims.quote: When you clear this option, the environment doesn't draw from unallocated prepaid capacity in the tenant after it consumes its allocation.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Caps; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Clearing tenant-pool draw does not prevent continued consumption through a linked pay-as-you-go billing plan.
claims.quote: If the environment is linked to a pay-as-you-go billing plan, usage can continue through the linked Azure subscription.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; controls[2]
claims.claim: An agent monthly limit can turn off the agent when Stop usage is enabled.
claims.quote: Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: An agent monthly limit does not stop agent flows called by the agent.
claims.quote: An agent's monthly limit doesn't stop the agent flows that the agent calls.

claims.claim: Agent flows are billed and checked for capacity separately.
claims.quote: Agent flows are billed and checked for capacity separately, and new agent flow runs are blocked only when the environment has no Copilot Credits available.

claims.claim: Limits are not applied instantly and an agent can keep responding for some time after reaching its limit.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.claim: When an environment has no available credits, credit-requiring experiences, including evaluations, can stop working.
claims.quote: When an environment has no available Copilot Credits, experiences that require credits can stop working. This limitation can affect both makers and end users.

claims.claim: The documented capacity and consumption controls apply across Copilot Studio, including the Microsoft Copilot harness.
claims.quote: The capacity and consumption controls in the Power Platform admin center apply across Copilot Studio. They aren't exclusive to the Microsoft Copilot harness.

claims.claim: Changes to shared capacity can affect other agents, workflows and features in the same environment.
claims.quote: Changes to shared capacity can affect other Copilot Studio agents, workflows, and features in the same environment.

claims.claim: An evaluation-only spending control, separate from other agent usage, is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio evaluation consumption reports separate evaluation usage hide credit display control; Power Platform API Copilot Studio agent monthly consumption limit. Opened harness cost management, capacity management, REST Bots and evaluation preview pages; no evaluation-only cap.

claims.claim: A control specifically hiding the evaluation cost display is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio evaluation hide credits; Copilot Studio evaluation credits display enable disable default roles permissions. Opened estimated-credit display, evaluation intro/create/view, capacity management and harness cost management; no display-hiding setting.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center provides environment and agent consumption reports.
claims.quote: From the Summary tab, you can download reports that organize consumption by environment, agent, or user.

claims.claim: The documentation does not explicitly state whether admin consumption reports separate evaluation usage.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio evaluation consumption reports separate evaluation usage hide credit display control. Opened capacity management and harness cost management. Reports document Product / AI feature, channel and model columns, but no explicit evaluation-usage category.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft does not document specific roles allowed to see the preview evaluation credit figures.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio evaluation credits permissions; Copilot Studio evaluation credits display enable disable default roles permissions. Read preview intro/create/view and standard evaluation results. Standard sharing roles are documented, but not preview credit-figure visibility roles.

claims.claim: The documented credit display reports estimates rather than configuring a cap or stopping usage.
claims.quote: Whenever a credit value is an estimate, the user interface includes an information icon and an explanatory message indicating that the value is intended for planning purposes and will be finalized later.

claims.claim: The agent monthly-limit configuration includes a notification threshold.
claims.quote:
Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit.
Configure the notification threshold.
Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: Learn advises reviewing environment and agent consumption together through Licensing > Copilot Studio in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Review environment and agent consumption together. A tenant-level total alone might not reveal an individual environment or agent that is consuming more credits than expected.

claims.claim: An agent's Monitor page is in Copilot Studio, not in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: The agent's Monitor page in Copilot Studio shows the agent's billed credits over time.

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to review consumption reports and limit status, but the controls table contains no consumption-monitoring row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Review environment and agent consumption together'. Table: 'Estimated Copilot Credits shown for an evaluation run and each test case'; 'Credits allocated to an environment, and whether it draws from tenant capacity'; 'Monthly Copilot Credit limit and Stop usage for one agent'.
claims.fix: The After rollout checklist's consumption-monitoring step has no corresponding table row. Remove its first bullet, 'Review environment and agent consumption together in the Power Platform admin center under Licensing > Copilot Studio, as Learn advises.' Keep the documented monitoring explanation in Governance controls.
